AfterQuery

AfterQuery builds expert-generated datasets and environments for frontier-model training. Its enterprise team also develops custom evaluations and deploys systems on a company’s own data.

What AfterQuery sells

Turns professional expertise into AI training data and practice tasks.

  • Office Agent Training Dataset · Professional assignments based on files. Tasks require analysis across several steps, with graded outputs.
  • SWE agent training datasets · Experts write tasks from private business codebases. Automated tests check the results.
  • Terminal-agent training data · Successful action records from command-line tasks (text commands used to operate a computer). Tasks run in isolated environments and earn rewards from tests.
  • Customer-service tool-use data · Service tasks with several steps. Checks confirm whether calls to software tools work correctly.
  • Custom RL environments · Training tasks using connected software tools or browser and desktop applications. Expert action records and grading support reinforcement learning (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores).
  • Expert demonstrations and feedback · Examples teach desired responses, with comparisons showing which answers experts prefer. Expert grading rules are paired with automated checks.
